ruleDefinitions.name: File In Suspicious Location Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64 where the files are located in potentially suspicious locations

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-encode.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/encode.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$Recycle\\\.Bin.*")))
